title: Expert Pistol Challenge Standards
text: Expert Pistol Challenge Standards Five drills, four levels. Run them after any SAPA training class to earn a spot on the list, and at Advanced or Expert, the SAPA challenge coin. Expert Pistol Challenge Standards Each drill has a time for every level. Shorter bar, faster time. 1) 3&2 Drill At 3 yrds draw and engage 3 shots to the body 2 shots to the head Novice 3.25 sec Intermediate 2.50 sec Advanced 2.20 sec Expert 2.00 sec 2) 1R1 At 3 yrds high compressed position. Begin retreating, shoot 1 round, emergency reload, shoot 1 round (all center mass) Novice 5.00 sec Intermediate 3.50 sec Advanced 3.00 sec Expert 2.50 sec 3) Draw Stroke From concealment at 7 yds, draw and fire 1 round. Run this drill two times and add both times together. Novice 4.00 sec Intermediate 3.00 sec Advanced 2.30 sec Expert 2.00 sec 4) Bill Drill At 7 yrds draw and engage center mass with 6 shots Novice 4.00 sec Intermediate 3.00 sec Advanced 2.20 sec Expert 2.00 sec 5) Stoppage Drill with a Twist At 15 yrds draw & engage 2 to the body 1 to the head, then sprint to 5 yrds line and engage 1 to the head 2 to the body Novice 12.00 sec Intermediate 9.00 sec Advanced 7.00 sec Expert 6.50 sec Where the hits have to land Novice Novice: Center mass shots in the white area of body and head shots in the white area of the head. Intermediate Intermediate: Center mass shots within the 10" circle & within the white area of the head. Advanced Advanced: Center mass shots within the 10" circle & within the white area of the head. Expert Expert: Center mass shots within the 8" circle and within the 4.5" circle of the head. Your level is the total *NOTE: Times above are only a guideline. The actual times for each level is a sum of each drill added together. Novice total time: 40.00 seconds Intermediate total time: 25.00 seconds Advanced Total Time: 17.00 seconds Expert Total Time: 15.00 seconds Line breakers only count if the carbon ring cuts the line. Ammunition must be factory ammunition, simulating the actual grain and recoil one would expect with self defense ammunition. How this works How this works: Target must be a SAPA target or IALEFI-Q target. Anyone who attends a training class with Small Arms Pistol Academy LLC will have the opportunity to run the Challenge Standards after the class. If you can meet all 5 with an Intermediate time your name will be added to the list online for bragging rights, it will only show the Top 10 most recent people. If you can meet all 5 drills within Adanced or Expert level you will earn an honorary SAPA challenge coin & your name will be added on the Advanced Pistol or Expert Pistol Challenge Completion list. NOTE: Novice times essentially are industry standard times. Difficult for a brand new shooter to achieve but should be the goal for every gun owner to reach. Intermediate times are that those who shoot more should try to achieve. Advanced times are of high quality shooters, typically those who have attended additional training classes will strive to reach this level. Expert times are typically the type of shooting times expected when attending training classes with some world class organizations. Expert level is for the top 2% of firearm owners. Anyone is able to attempt this challenge; however, the only way to earn the coin or have your name added to the list, you MUST preform the standards at one of the Training Classes offered by SAPA. title: Class Descriptions
text: Class Descriptions We offer a wide array of services to meet the demands of the clientele. Some people want to get a pistol permit to just secure the firearms in the death of a loved one. Others wish to carry in public for self defense. Some want to challenge themselves in a whole new way with hunting through the use of a pistol. Whatever your interest in firearms is, from brand new to a seasoned shooter, different classes for different people are offered. Register for a class by clicking here! NYS Carry Concealed Pistol Permit $250 per student Carry Concealed Class NYS Carry Concealed Pistol Permit. Pick a date below and reserve your seat. Register for this class Text 716-397-5769 One on One Training $125 per class This type of training is ~2 hours in length and the focus of the class will be whatever YOU want to become more proficent at. Cost of this type of training is $125 per class. Exampe: How to clean a gun, how to shoot more accurately, shoot while moving, utilization of barricades, how to draw your firearm more efficiently. Text to book Scheduled around you Group Training $75 Women Only (Basic) *This class is ~2 hours in length. If you already own a pistol you can bring that with or you can try out some of the most popular firearms from my personal collection. This is a very basic class, it allows someone with very little knowledge or confidence in their firearm ability to learn the proper way to handle a firearm. Proper training allows a new shooter to build confidence and preform PERFECT safe handling with their firearm. Register $100 Your Rights *This class is ~5 hours in length. If you have ever had a legal question or one of those "What if..." thoughts this is a perfect class for you to attend. With topics covering from mindset, use of force, legal & what to do when police arrive. Local guest speakers include a licensed attorney and law enforcement officer. They can answer the legal questions. This is an informational class so bring your pen & notepad! Register $75 Continuation of Training *This class is ~2 hours in length. This class is not limited to just males or females but open to anyone. It is offered monthly. Each month the specific topic of the class will change while still implimenting the perfect fundamentals for a safe range experience yet geared towards more realisitic situations. Some topic examples are: drawing a firearm, conducting a magazine reload, walking while shooting & shooting moving targets. Register $200 Pistol Level 1 This 6 hour course lays the foundation for all future pistol training. Safety, range etiquette, loading, equipment, fundamentals of shooting, draw-stroke, clearing stoppages, common mistakes, and proper mindset are the main subjects tackled in this essential course. Though this training is designed for beginners, the subject matter and technique allows all students to build realistic skills. Register $250 Prior SAPA training required Pistol Level 2 This 1 day course begins with a review of safety protocols and an audit of each individual’s shooting fundamentals and basic skill sets (draw stroke, reloads, etc). During this course, students will learn use of cover/concealment, concealed carry considerations, fighter mindset, advantages of red dots and introduction to shooting while moving. Prior SAPA training is required to be eligible to attend this course, must have completed SAPA Pistol Level 1 prior) Register Register for a class Pick a date, enter your details and reserve your seat. Payment is arranged with Mike before class.
